movie.description: When YouTuber-boxer Danial insults their late father's name, brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite - one fighting for redemption, the other for revenge - in a battle that will decide not just who wins, but what remains of The Furious legacy.

movie.name: Bí Kíp Tình Ái
movie.description: Guided by Ataska, this sensual THREE-act showcase explores six iconic sex positions in escalating intensity as demonstrated in VMX movies. Get in position, stay in rhythm, feel every move and get ready to sweat.

movie.name: Mayumi
movie.description: A young woman sparks her friend’s first taste of desire, setting him on a path of sexual awakening. But as emotions deepen, their connection leads to unexpected heartbreak and self-discovery.

movie.name: Ai Là Kẻ Sát Nhân?
movie.description: When an English man is accused of murdering his Thai in-laws, his wife is the only witness that stands between guilt and freedom.

movie.name: Gia Tài Của Người Chết
movie.description: Two bank employees who try to steal from an unclaimed account, only to discover the money belongs to dangerous individuals eager to reclaim it.

movie.name: Black Clover: Thanh Kiếm Của Ma Pháp Vương
movie.description: In a world where magic is everything, Asta, a boy who was born with no magic, aims to become the "Wizard King" to overcome adversity, prove his power, and keep his oath with his friends.

movie.name: RE:BORN
movie.description: A legend covert soldier with a mysterious past now decides to once again unleash his beast inside of him to stand up for what he cares about.

movie.name: Bông Hoa Ước Vọng
movie.description: After the death of his wife, Jong-Sub (Kang Shin Sung Il) raised his son alone. He lost his son in a car accident. Since the death of his son, Jong-Sub lived all alone. He retired from his job as a principle. Jong-Sub is then diagnosed with colon cancer and learns he has only 6 months left to live. All his desire to live is gone, but he still wants to keep his dignity. Jong-Sub tries to hire a caregiver. A woman named Yeon-Hwa (Bae Seul-Ki) comes to him. She is beautiful, but looks sad. Watching Yeon-Hwa, Jong-Sub sees his dead wife. He is shaken by her and wants to live more with her. Jong-Sub realizes he loves her and faces a truth he can't believe.

movie.name: Độc Chiến
movie.description: A police detective determined to catch the unseen boss of Asia's biggest drug cartel joins hands with a revenge-thirsty member of the gang.

movie.name: Ma Xó
movie.description: Desperate to protect her unborn child after a miscarriage, Thao performs a ritual to summon a "Ma Xo" spirit. But when the entity demands a horrific debt, she realizes the protector she invited in is an inescapable nightmare.

movie.name: Mùi Phở
movie.description: A story of generational conflict and the clash between tradition and modern life, centered on phở—an icon of Vietnamese cuisine. Beneath the disputes and disagreements, hidden truths gradually surface, unfolding a journey back to familial warmth through humor, wit, and charming moments.

movie.name: Hẹn Em Ngày Nhật Thực
movie.description: In 1995, a young Catholic woman at the end of noviciate finds herself shaken by the flashbacks of a long gone first love.

movie.name: Cưới Vợ Cho Cha
movie.description: In a quaint village nestled in the West Vietnam, Mr. Sau Seu, a karaoke cafe owner, resides alone, eagerly awaiting his son Ut Tung’s return from Saigon for a visit. However, his hopes are shattered when he discovers he has a grave illness. To fulfill his promise to his late wife, he decides to “marry his son off.” However, this plan takes an unexpected turn when he learns that Tung has a shocking secret and is concealing it. Amidst conflicts, misunderstandings, and attempts at reconciliation, father and son gradually gain a deeper understanding of each other. Ultimately, they find happiness and peace in their own unique marriages.

movie.name: Lầu Chú Hỏa
movie.description: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

movie.name: Hoàng Tử Quỷ
movie.description: The movie The  Demon Prince (Hoàng Tử Quỷ) marks the first collaboration between CJ HK Entertainment and the duo Producer Hoang Quan – Director Tran Huu Tan from ProductionQ. The film is inspired by the famous horror novel Lý Triều Dị Truyện by author Phan Cuong. This fictional collection, steeped in mystique and set during Vietnam's Ly Dynasty, builds on folklore about ghosts, dark magic, courtly secrets, and popular fears. The work opens up a world where forgotten legends come to life, reflecting the greed, ambition, and obsessions within every human being.  The film The  Demon Prince (Hoàng Tử Quỷ) is expected to premiere in cinemas nationwide starting from December 5, 2025.

movie.name: Làm Giàu Với Ma 2: Cuộc Chiến Hột Xoàn
movie.description: Five individuals embark on a darkly comedic journey, each with their own schemes, to transport the body of actress Anh Thu (Ngoc Xuan) back to her hometown. In return, her ghost promises them a diamond ring worth 9 billion VND. Who will claim the prize, or will the trip reveal their darkest selves?

movie.name: Nhà Gia Tiên
movie.description: A Gen Z content creator returns to her ancestral home seeking viral material, only to encounter her deceased brother’s ghost while dealing with avaricious relatives.

movie.name: Cu Li Không Bao Giờ Khóc
movie.description: A woman tries to cling onto dimming links to her past after inheriting a pygmy slow loris from her long-estranged husband; meanwhile, her niece prepares for marriage as the young couple ponders their gloomy future together. The present and the complex echoes of Vietnamese history are entwined before a contemplative and poetic perspective.

movie.name: Chị Dậu
movie.description: In colonial French Indochina, a woman sells her daughter and four dogs in a desperate attempt to save her husband from torture when they can’t pay off the government taxes.

movie.name: Chị Tư Hậu
movie.description: Tư Hậu is a common woman from a fishing village whose husband has gone away to fight in the revolution. She takes care of her young daughter as well as her aging father-in-law. Soon, her peaceful village is attacked.

movie.name: Người Đàn Bà Mộng Du

movie.name: Vào Nam Ra Bắc

movie.name: Ngã Ba Đồng Lộc

They had to overcome many life-and-death challenges and enormous adversities in order to mobilise the masses to prepare for an uprising and seize power from the Japanese fascists, in a situation where the country fell into the tragedy of famine.

BA HƠN, the beloved son of Hội đồng Lịnh — the owner of Vietnam's first bank — returns from studying in France and squanders his entire inheritance on lavish parties and extravagant pleasures, earning him the nickname Công Tử Bạc Liêu

movie.name: Mặt Trời Trong Đêm
movie.description: In 1967, as the Vietnam War raged, a Vietnamese revolutionary guerrilla team became the U.S. military's top target—charged with safeguarding a secret group of intelligence agents at all costs.

movie.name: Những Đứa Trẻ Trong Sương
movie.description: Di is a 12-year-old girl from the mist-shrouded mountains of northern Vietnam. She belongs to the Hmong, an ethnic minority in which girls get married at a very young age. This is often preceded by a controversial “bride-napping,” where the girl is abducted by her future husband on New Year’s Eve. Negotiations between the families follow.  This also happened to Di’s sister and their mother, so it doesn’t seem strange that in preparation the women and girls discuss sex and married life without embarrassment. But Di also goes to school, where she learns very different values. And in her own way, even Di’s mother tries to warn her daughter about child marriage.

By chance, he ends up in Mrs. Le's boarding house and, together with his friends there, experiences the most memorable days of his youth.

When others had evacuated to the war zone, they decided to defend the capital that had been devastated by bombs and bullets, despite the dangers that awaited them.

Because of the secrets and word of mouth of the villagers about the old house being haunted by the ghost of Miss Trinh, the guests who came to buy the house also left. The story only really started when Mrs. Mai Lien - Mr. Nga's wife died mysteriously, and Betty's granddaughter Ngoc returned to her hometown with her was also missing, everything began to gradually reveal interesting and non-stop drama. by the end of the movie.

After a much-heated discussion about how smartphones influence their personal lives, the group proposes a late-night game:  everyone is to place their mobiles on the table; whoever gets a text, notification or call must share it with the group. It is a recipe for disaster.

movie.name: Đất Rừng Phương Nam
movie.description: As French colonial rule reaches a violent end in Vietnam, a 12 year old boy makes a treacherous journey in search of his estranged father.

movie.description: The story revolves around Mrs. Nu's family consisting of three generations living together in the same house. The one-handed Mrs. Nu is known for her crab cakes and is also notorious for controlling the lives of everyone, from her daughter to her son-in-law. Everything was going normally until the youngest daughter fell in love with a handsome guy from a rich family. The story depicts the complex, multi-dimensional relationships that occur with family members. The main tagline (message) "Everyone is at fault, but everyone thinks they are... the victim" contains many hidden meanings about the content the film wants to convey.

movie.name: Án Mạng Lầu 4
movie.description: With just a few hours before heading to the airport, a kind-hearted couple agreed to babysit a newborn baby from their neighbor. Little did they know, shortly thereafter, they discovered that the baby had passed away since... A thrilling and heart-wrenching story unfolded in the fateful evening at their old apartment building. The couple had to rack their brains to escape this dire situation, while also uncovering the culprit who pushed them into this predicament.

movie.name: Cô Dâu Đại Chiến
movie.description: In the heart of Saigon, Thai and Linh are getting married. But the wedding is suddenly cut short when four other brides show up – threatening to take the groom's life. It turns out that Thai is the biggest player in the city, and has been dating all five women at the same time up until the day of his wedding. Trang is an overly jealous flight attendant, Mai Chau is a doctor who loves to party, Quyen is a sexually aggressive chef while Huynh Phuong is one fiery actress.

Quang Hy (by Hai) wants to take nude “artistic’ photos. They meet and Quang Hy lies that he’s a director to get Ngo Dong to participate in taking photos. Their relationship begins.

While trying to stay alive, An found something more important than life itself - love.

Tian Anye, a humble charcoal seller, unintentionally gets entangled in this conspiracy. In a series of intense battles where allies and enemies become blurred, the secrets hidden within Tian Anye and the truth behind the sacrifice of the people in Liang City are unveiled. In the end, Tian Anye fights against the imperial soldiers, saving a mother and child and escaping from the city of Chang'an.

series.name: KinnPorsche The Series

series.name: Tiêu Dao
series.description: A young inn attendant and a descendant of the goddess embark on a quest to find a bead that can end a drought. They befriend allies and face dangers, ultimately thwarting a sect leader's scheme to destroy the world.

series.name: Tứ Hải Trọng Minh
series.description: Nan Yan enters the fairyland to save her mother, inadvertently triggering a marriage pact with the emperor Ji Yang, who conceals his true identity. As she navigates the realm, she uncovers a sinister conspiracy.

series.description: Trapped in a fictional realm, Xiaoyu finds herself forced into the narrative as a persecuted heroine, subject to the cruelty of the male protagonist Nanheng. She resists but is bound by the storyline's predetermined path.

series.name: Thương Lan Quyết
series.description: A fairy whose tribe was in war with Moon Demon Lord, Qingcang meets him and mutual incantation and mutual curse ties their lives.

series.name: Trường Phong Độ
series.description: Liu Yuru has suffered in her family; her only hope is to marry her crush, but fateful events force her to marry a rumored playboy from a rich family, Gu Jiusi. She then learns business from her mother-in-law and turns her fate for...

series.name: Tiên Đài Có CC�y
series.description: After a long day, high schooler Shintaro Tokumitsu's plans for relaxing in his studio apartment take a turn when he discovers an angel on his balcony. The divine girl, Towa, reveals she's there to study humanity, and yet, despite his skepticism, he agrees to put her up. Prepare for the most heavenly and high jinks roommate experience of all time!

series.name: Phù Đồ Duyên
series.description: During the reign of Long Hua, court power struggles intertwine with a forbidden romance. Xiao Duo, a formidable eunuch conspiring with Prince Fu to seize the throne, rescues Bu Yinlou, a tribute lady meant to die for the late emperor. Forced into each other’s lives, they slowly fall in love despite their unequal status. Their bond deepens on a journey to Jiangnan, but threats from rival factions, the palace, and Xiao Duo’s hidden identity place them in constant danger. Caught between love and ambition, they must navigate betrayal and sacrifice as fate pushes them toward a perilous future.

series.name: Lâm Giang Tiên
series.description: Li Qingyue, the Four Spirit Immortal, and Bai Jiusi, the powerful Dacheng Lord, are caught in a turbulent love-hate relationship. As hidden truths come to light, they overcome their misunderstandings and join forces to protect the world from impending danger.

series.name: Hoa Nhung

series.name: Bảy Kiếp May Mắn
series.description: The two of little fairy Xiangyun and immortal Chukong in the Marriage Pavilion are intertwined with the ancient red thread, becoming bound immortal couples and creating a series of romantic, joyful, and tumultuous seven life love ...

series.name: Nhan Tâm Ký
series.description: Three ninja siblings, Ginga [Galaxy] Mitsurugi, Suisei [Comet] Mitsurugi, and Gekko [Moonlight] Mitsurugi, battle the alien warriors of the Scorpion Army.

series.name: Vãn Phong Từ
series.description: Occult detective Inugami travels to a rural village to investigate a case. There he finds the half-human boy Kabane, who wants to find his parents.

series.name: Đông Chí

series.name: Liên Hoa Lâu
series.description: A decade after a fierce battle, Li Xiang Yi wishes to live life as Li Lian Hua, an unassuming doctor. However, his plan is upended when he encounters Fang Duo Bing, a passionate detective, and an old enemy seeking to settle a score.

series.name: Định Phong Ba
series.description: A girl becomes the empress to fix her corrupt and cruel country.

series.name: Mị Ảnh Thần Bộ
series.description: About an antisocial high school student named Hikigaya Hachiman with a distorted view on life and no friends or girlfriend. His life change when he was forced to enter the "Volunteer Service Club" by his teacher.

series.name: Người Thầy Y Đức
series.description: "Romantic Doctor Kim" is a "real doctor" story set in a small, humble hospital called Dol Dam Hospital. It is a story about people who meet Kim Sa Bu (Han Suk Kyu), a genius doctor, and discover "real romance."

series.name: Pls Love: Yêu Được Không
series.description: A man with a job interpreting other languages meets a woman who speaks love in a completely opposite way to him, but they understand each other.

series.name: Tôi Không Phải Là Đại Sư
series.description: A recluse takes the opportunity to enter another world, but his status there as an overpowered hero makes his desire for a quiet life difficult.

series.name: Trách Em Quá Xinh Đẹp
series.description: Mo Xiangwan, a determined showbiz agent, faces a career setback that challenges her to rediscover her purpose. After losing two key clients due to a strategic mistake, she learns from veteran actors and shifts her focus to creating impactful projects. Along the way, she meets Mo Bei, a successful commercial lawyer, as she strives to rebuild her career and chase her dreams.

series.name: Danh Sách Mua Sắm Của Kẻ Sát Nhân
series.description: One day, a dead body is found at an apartment near the supermarket. Finding this murder odd, Dae-sung, his mother, and his girlfriend Ah-hee gather around to find the real murderer, starting by looking through the receipts of the market.

series.name: Đi Đến Nơi Có Gió
series.description: After the death of her best friend, Xu Hongdou decided to quit her job and have herself a vacation in Dali, Yunnan. There, she met wonderful people and did wonderful things.

series.name: Hoa Thiên Cốt 2015
series.description: Born under an ominous star with a mysterious scent that attracts demons, a young woman sets out to find a master who can teach her to protect herself from the supernatural forces drawn to her.

series.name: Tân Bạch Nương Tử Truyền Kỳ
series.description: Provoked by the actions of a seemingly sly human, an ancient snake spirit takes on a human form, in order to prove him a fraud. Convinced she’s doing the world a favor, Bai Su Zhen challenges Xu Xuan to a contest of skill but what starts as a heated rivalry soon turns to burning passion. Faced with opposition from every side, Bai Su Zhen and Xu Xuan’s love is put to the test time and time again.

series.name: Bề Tôi Trung Thành Nhất
series.description: It tells the story of Yuji Sano who inadvertently accepts a summon to another world. Now, he has to get back to the mountain of work he left behind.

series.name: Gấp Ánh Trăng
series.description: The unlikely love story between a crown prince and his eunuch.

series.name: Hồng Trần Tứ Hợp
series.description: Near the end of the Yuan Dynasty, different camps of fighters wreak havoc in the realm of combat. There are rumors that the possessor of Dragon Slaying Saber and Heavenly Sword can become the invincible fighter

series.description: The story was about Akshara and Naitik who were bounded by a forcefully arranged marriage thrust upon them by hypocritical society, carried on for seasons as Akshara saved lives (as one does) while being sanskari and lovable.Karti...

series.name: Minh Xuyên Hữu Tri Hạ
series.description: 29-year-old Satoru Fujinuma is sent back in time 18 years to prevent the events leading to his mother's death, which began with a series of kidnappings while he was in 5th grade.

series.name: Bách Yêu Phổ
series.description: A skilled healer opens an underground clinic after being mistreated by his party!.

series.name: Dẫn Đăng Quyết
series.description: In Republican-era China, a century-old vampire survives a brutal assassination attempt with the help of a mortal blind girl. Both lonely souls, they soon find companionship amidst danger and chaos. But can their bond overcome their differences?

series.name: Nhất Chẩm Xuân Hoa
series.description: Fashion buyer Gu Xixi bought Alex's couture wedding dresses for her clients. During a private reception, she got acquainted with Yin Sichen, the black-bellied president who came to discuss business cooperation with Alex. An incident occured leading to the two people to temporarily maintain a contract cooperative relationship for a win-win situation pertaining to Alex. The two with opposite personalities gradually found love in this contract marriage. Adapted from novel "Flash Marriage CEO's Contract Wife" by Xiang Wang.

series.name: Định Luật 80/20 Của Tình Yêu
series.description: Facing numerous crises, Qin Shi and Yang Hua begin to slowly fall for each other, and fortuitously acquire true love.

series.name: Cẩm Tâm Tựa Ngọc
series.description: Despite being born with low status, Luo Shiyiniang is extremely assertive and believes that a woman's vision should not be limited to the household. She hopes to rely on her embroidery skills as a ticket to freedom. However, the once-esteemed Luo family is in a state of decline. Hoping to save the clan through a marriage alliance, Shiyiniang is selected to become the wife of Yongping Duke and great general Xu Lingyi. Things were not easy for Shiyiniang due to the Xu family's biases towards her. Nonetheless, she manages to win their trust through her optimism and sincerity. Xu Lingyi also becomes attracted to Shiyiniang's various beautiful qualities such that husband and wife find love after marriage.

series.name: Trường Phong Phá Lãng (Truy Phong Giả)
series.description: Follows a financial genius who serves as a low-level employee of the Kuomintang Central Bank. He establishes his communist beliefs and takes the lead in the party's financial front.

series.name: Nạn Nhân Không Hoàn Hảo
series.description: Waking from a fatal accident to find herself in the past, Han Yi-joo teams up with Seo Do-guk to take revenge on the family who never loved her.

series.name: Thiên Khởi Dị Văn Lục
series.description: During the late Ming Dynasty a mysterious epidemic breaks out. It follows the thrilling journey of Chu Sijing, a member of the secret service, as he navigates a life-or-death crisis on a deserted island.

series.name: Người Thanh Trừng Chấp Niệm Bất Lương
series.description: After a near-fatal accident, Pu Yi Yong's regular life is turned upside down as he unexpectedly gains the ability to see wandering spirits. With the aid of his high school nemesis and a rookie cop, he sets out to help them rest in...

series.name: Phong Khởi Lạc Dương
series.description: Gao Bingzhu, wrongly accused, teams up with Baili Hongyi to investigate his father's poisoning and Wu Siyue's case. Despite class differences and initial clashes, they uncover a sinister conspiracy that could destroy the city.

series.name: Chân Tướng Trầm Mặc
series.description: A suspect is caught red-handed in a murder but the seemingly open-and-shut case takes a shocking turn. A dogged prosecutor spends a decade investigating, sacrificing everything to uncover the truth behind the crime.

series.name: Phong Vũ Nhạn Hoa
series.description: High school student Jiro Yakuin gets paired with Akari Watanabe, a gal who finds him repulsive at first, but they agree to attain enough points so that they can switch partners to the people they really like.

series.name: Lại Là Em Oh Hae Young
series.description: A romantic television series about two women who not only share the same name Oh Hae Young but they also share a destiny with the same man, Park Do Kyung, who can see the future.

series.name: Tiền Bối, Đừng Đánh Màu Son Đó
series.description: Yoon Song Ah works as a marketer for a cosmetics brand. She enjoys her job and dreams of launching her own brand someday. Chae Hyun Seung is a fellow marketer who becomes attracted to Yoon Song Ah. He tries to develop a romantic relationship but Yoon Song Ah rebuffs his advances, not wishing to date younger men.

series.name: Hậu Duệ Mặt Trời
series.description: This drama tells of the love story that develops between a surgeon and a special forces officer.

series.name: Cách Mạng Tình Yêu
series.description: A major accident takes the lives of 48 people. The lives of the survivors, those who lost loved ones and those connected to the parties blamed for the tragic event are also marked forever.

series.name: Những Người Thừa Kế
series.description: After a chance encounter in LA, two teens from different social backgrounds reunite at an exclusive high school attended by Korea's über rich.

series.name: Mật Danh K2
series.description: A highly trained special ops agent goes off the grid after being framed for murder, and is hired as a bodyguard when the powerful and influential father of a troubled girl sees his skills.

series.name: Cửa Hàng Tiện Lợi Saet Byul
series.description: It tells an unpredictable 24-hour love story of the four-dimensional innocent girl Jung Saet Byeol who was once a troublemaker and the adorkable caring male store manager, Choi Dae Hyun, in the context of a convenience store. They have met each other accidentally 4 years ago, back then Saet Byeol asked Dae Hyun to buy cigarettes for them. Until now, Saet Byeol comes to the convenience store Dae Hyun runs for a part-time job, their hilarious romantic story starts.

series.name: Bác Sĩ Ma
series.description: Cha Young Min is a genius doctor but arrogant and selfish. One day, he gets involved in an unexpected case; his spirit possesses another doctor's body. These two doctors are complete opposites, with personalities and medical abili...

series.name: Ngày Nắng Đẹp
series.description: Kim Ji-ho is a broken hearted man who winds up in Jeju Island for a work project but he keeps running into a girl. Both of them get robbed and have to sleep in the same guest house. They depend on each other for a day as his wallet and her phone got stolen. As they stay in Jeju Island, she heals his broken heart and they fall in love.

series.name: Vô Tình Tìm Thấy Haru
series.description: When a high-school girl finds that she is merely a character from a comic book whose destiny is decided by the writer, she decides to change the plot to suit her desires and find the love of her life.

series.name: Thủy Long Ngâm
series.description: When an influential and fearsome clan is massacred in mysterious circumstances, the clan’s talented disciple Tang Lici finds himself accused of masterminding the crime. Accusers say that Tang Lici is a traitor who murdered his master. A decade later, suspicions about Tang Lici linger, but much darker forces are conspiring to unleash chaos into the realm. Torn by his duality and his apparent inability to distinguish between good and evil, Tang Lici finds himself drawn back into the wider world to help defeat the evil conspiracy – armed only with his wits and his martial arts skills. His path soon crosses with former acquaintances, with some swearing enmity and others allied to his cause. Can he and his companions help defeat the forces of wickedness – or will his dual nature prove his undoing?

series.name: Đại Lý Tự Thiếu Khanh Du
series.description: In the imperial capital of the Tang Dynasty, the mysterious Li Bing is appointed Assistant Minister of Dali Temple. With a team of eccentric investigators, he unravels complex cases and uncovers hidden truths beneath the city’s surface. As they face danger and deception, they stand united in their pursuit of justice.

series.name: Ve Sầu
series.description: The story of a group of young friends and the mysterious events that occur in the rural village of Hinamizawa.

series.name: Thanh Xuân Đón Gió
series.description: A boy who's been brutally bullied all his life discovers a door to another world, which grants him access to cheat skills and opportunities to live a better life.

series.name: Tình Yêu Và Âm Mưu
series.description: Gopi finds her younger self in Gehna while visiting the selfish and greedy Desais. But when their youngest son returns home, things take an unexpected turn..

series.name: Anh Hùng Xạ Điêu
series.description: During the Jin-Song Wars, two widowed mothers flee. Their sons, honest Guo Jing and scheming Yang Kang, reunite with lovers Huang Rong and Mu Nianci, facing adventures involving the Five Greats.

series.name: Khi Nàng Say Giấc
series.description: The drama is about a woman, Nam Hong Joo, who can see accidents that take place in the future through her dreams. And a prosecutor, Jung Jae Chan, who struggles to stop the woman's dreams from coming true.

series.name: Thanh Xuân Vật Vã
series.description: Ko Dong Man, a former taekwondo champion, and Choi Ae Ra, a receptionist, struggle to follow their dreams as life throws obstacles in their path.

series.name: Cô Nàng Xinh Đẹp
series.description: When Ji Sung-Joon was young, he was ugly. As he grew up, he began to have an attractive appearance. When Kim Hye-Jin was young, she was pretty. As she grew up, she became ugly. Ji Sung-Joon tries to find his first love.

series.name: Chạm Vào Tim Em
series.description: An affair between a lawyer and a first-rate actress, whose life goes downhill after being involved in a scandal. She fakes her position to become the lawyer's secretary and star in a writer's drama.

series.name: Thiếu Nữ Mang Khôi Giáp
series.description: Sang Tian is an aspiring figure skater. On the day she turns 18, she vows to her family that she will be accepted to the same university that her mother once attended. To get in, she must pass a test, which she – an exceptionally competent skater and student – expects to ace.

vnMovie.name: Quỷ Nhập Tràng 2
vnMovie.description: A young woman returns to her family's dye workshop after years of exile, only to confront supernatural events and the brutal truth behind her mother's death and a long-buried blood pact. A prequel to Quy Nhap Trang (2025).

vnMovie.name: Phá Đám: Sinh Nhật Mẹ
vnMovie.description: Threatened by gangsters, a son stages a fake funeral for his mother to scam an insurance payout.

vnMovie.name: Ma Xó
vnMovie.description: Desperate to protect her unborn child after a miscarriage, Thao performs a ritual to summon a "Ma Xo" spirit. But when the entity demands a horrific debt, she realizes the protector she invited in is an inescapable nightmare.

vnMovie.name: Mùi Phở
vnMovie.description: A story of generational conflict and the clash between tradition and modern life, centered on phở—an icon of Vietnamese cuisine. Beneath the disputes and disagreements, hidden truths gradually surface, unfolding a journey back to familial warmth through humor, wit, and charming moments.

vnMovie.name: Hẹn Em Ngày Nhật Thực
vnMovie.description: In 1995, a young Catholic woman at the end of noviciate finds herself shaken by the flashbacks of a long gone first love.

vnMovie.name: Cưới Vợ Cho Cha
vnMovie.description: In a quaint village nestled in the West Vietnam, Mr. Sau Seu, a karaoke cafe owner, resides alone, eagerly awaiting his son Ut Tung’s return from Saigon for a visit. However, his hopes are shattered when he discovers he has a grave illness. To fulfill his promise to his late wife, he decides to “marry his son off.” However, this plan takes an unexpected turn when he learns that Tung has a shocking secret and is concealing it. Amidst conflicts, misunderstandings, and attempts at reconciliation, father and son gradually gain a deeper understanding of each other. Ultimately, they find happiness and peace in their own unique marriages.

vnMovie.name: Lầu Chú Hỏa
vnMovie.description: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

vnMovie.name: Hoàng Tử Quỷ
vnMovie.description: The movie The  Demon Prince (Hoàng Tử Quỷ) marks the first collaboration between CJ HK Entertainment and the duo Producer Hoang Quan – Director Tran Huu Tan from ProductionQ. The film is inspired by the famous horror novel Lý Triều Dị Truyện by author Phan Cuong. This fictional collection, steeped in mystique and set during Vietnam's Ly Dynasty, builds on folklore about ghosts, dark magic, courtly secrets, and popular fears. The work opens up a world where forgotten legends come to life, reflecting the greed, ambition, and obsessions within every human being.  The film The  Demon Prince (Hoàng Tử Quỷ) is expected to premiere in cinemas nationwide starting from December 5, 2025.

vnMovie.name: Làm Giàu Với Ma 2: Cuộc Chiến Hột Xoàn
vnMovie.description: Five individuals embark on a darkly comedic journey, each with their own schemes, to transport the body of actress Anh Thu (Ngoc Xuan) back to her hometown. In return, her ghost promises them a diamond ring worth 9 billion VND. Who will claim the prize, or will the trip reveal their darkest selves?

vnMovie.name: Nhà Gia Tiên
vnMovie.description: A Gen Z content creator returns to her ancestral home seeking viral material, only to encounter her deceased brother’s ghost while dealing with avaricious relatives.

vnMovie.name: Cu Li Không Bao Giờ Khóc
vnMovie.description: A woman tries to cling onto dimming links to her past after inheriting a pygmy slow loris from her long-estranged husband; meanwhile, her niece prepares for marriage as the young couple ponders their gloomy future together. The present and the complex echoes of Vietnamese history are entwined before a contemplative and poetic perspective.

vnMovie.name: Chị Dậu
vnMovie.description: In colonial French Indochina, a woman sells her daughter and four dogs in a desperate attempt to save her husband from torture when they can’t pay off the government taxes.

vnMovie.name: Chị Tư Hậu
vnMovie.description: Tư Hậu is a common woman from a fishing village whose husband has gone away to fight in the revolution. She takes care of her young daughter as well as her aging father-in-law. Soon, her peaceful village is attacked.

vnMovie.name: Người Đàn Bà Mộng Du
vnMovie.description: A young woman struggles to move on from the consuming grief of her experience as a combat medic in the Trường Sơn mountains during Vietnam War .

vnMovie.name: Vào Nam Ra Bắc
vnMovie.description: At a dance bar, a former soldier and now company director chances upon a hostess whose appearance resembles the young girl that saved his life many years ago in the War.

vnMovie.name: Mùi cỏ cháy
vnMovie.description: This military drama weaves together the diaries and memories of North Vietnamese soldiers who fought in the ferocious 1972 battle of Quang Tri.

vnMovie.name: Ngã Ba Đồng Lộc
vnMovie.description: Based on a true story of 10 young women, who volunteered to help with logistic activities at Đồng Lộc junction, a strategic junction of Ho Chi Minh trail during the Vietnam War.

vnMovie.name: Giải Phóng Sài Gòn
vnMovie.description: The story of liberation of Saigon by People's Army of Vietnam and National Liberation Front of South Vietnam on 30 April 1975.

vnMovie.name: Chung Một Dòng Sông
vnMovie.description: Hoài and Vận fall in love during the war against the French. Vận fought as a guerrilla and Vận ferried guerrillas across the river. When peace comes, Vietnam is  divided in two across the Bến Hải River, leaving them separated.

vnMovie.name: Sao Tháng 8
vnMovie.description: The plot of the film revolves around revolutionary soldiers who come from different classes, but all share the same patriotism. They had to overcome many life-and-death challenges and enormous adversities in order to mobilise the masses to prepare for an uprising and seize power from the Japanese fascists, in a situation where the country fell into the tragedy of famine.

vnMovie.name: Em bé Hà Nội
vnMovie.description: A young girl searches for her father, a soldier in the PAVN, after her mother and sister are killed during Christmas Bombings.

vnMovie.name: Bao giờ cho đến tháng Mười
vnMovie.description: In the final days of the war, Duyên faces a daily struggle to take care of her young son and ailing father-in-law, all the while hiding from them the fact that her husband has recently been killed in battle.

vnMovie.name: Đường Thư
vnMovie.description: Two soldiers are tasked with mailing an urgent letter to a battalion surrounded by the enemies’ forces.

vnMovie.name: Công Tử Bạc Liêu
vnMovie.description: Inspired by the famous tales of the man known as the "Most Extravagant Playboy," Công Tử Bạc Liêu is a comedic drama set in the Southern Six Provinces of colonial-era Vietnam. BA HƠN, the beloved son of Hội đồng Lịnh — the owner of Vietnam's first bank — returns from studying in France and squanders his entire inheritance on lavish parties and extravagant pleasures, earning him the nickname Công Tử Bạc Liêu

vnMovie.name: Mặt Trời Trong Đêm
vnMovie.description: In 1967, as the Vietnam War raged, a Vietnamese revolutionary guerrilla team became the U.S. military's top target—charged with safeguarding a secret group of intelligence agents at all costs.

vnMovie.name: Những Đứa Trẻ Trong Sương
vnMovie.description: Di is a 12-year-old girl from the mist-shrouded mountains of northern Vietnam. She belongs to the Hmong, an ethnic minority in which girls get married at a very young age. This is often preceded by a controversial “bride-napping,” where the girl is abducted by her future husband on New Year’s Eve. Negotiations between the families follow.  This also happened to Di’s sister and their mother, so it doesn’t seem strange that in preparation the women and girls discuss sex and married life without embarrassment. But Di also goes to school, where she learns very different values. And in her own way, even Di’s mother tries to warn her daughter about child marriage.

vnMovie.name: Giải Cứu Thần Chết
vnMovie.description: After watching the film Nu Hon Than Chet (Kiss of the Death), a dreamy clumsy high-school girl, An, wishes that she can meet a Prince Reaper that helps her to complete her dream. As her wish, An runs into this Teen Reaper. However, he's such a clumsy Reaper that he creates a lot of trouble for An. Instead of being rescued, An has to "save" this Teen Reaper's life.

vnMovie.name: Gái Già Lắm Chiêu 2
vnMovie.description: The life of fame is suddenly a series of bad luck that makes Ms Q face many challenges if she wants to regain her position. At the same time, Jack - a young apprentice appeared and Ms Q was "drunk". Will Ms Q save his career? What is Jack's real identity?

vnMovie.name: Cô Dâu Hào Môn
vnMovie.description: A family attempts to fraudulently pass off their daughter as a trophy bride for an elite family, aiming to secure their fortune, based on the traditional Vietnamese belief that couples should have similar social and economic status.

vnMovie.name: Bố Già
vnMovie.description: The story of Ba Sang – the second of the 4 noisy siblings: Giau, Sang, Phu, Quy. Ba Sang is a meddler, “too” kind and always sacrifice for others despite they want it or not. Quan – Ba Sang’s son is a modern young Youtuber.

vnMovie.name: 49 Ngày 2
vnMovie.description: Sequel to the movie '49 Days'. The film revolves around a guy named Huy who lost his memory due to an accident, more tragically he was stalked by a beautiful ghost who lost her memory.

vnMovie.name: Lối Thoát Cuối Cùng
vnMovie.description: A young man enters the Vietnamese-American underworld after his crimelord father is murdered.

vnMovie.name: Người Cần Quên Phải Nhớ
vnMovie.description: While investigating a criminal conspiracy, a hard-charging journalist unwittingly falls for her source -- a sweet-talking thug with amnesia.

vnMovie.name: Em Chưa 18
vnMovie.description: A playboy's life changes after he met and slept with a girl who hasn't turned 18 yet.

vnMovie.name: Áo Lụa Hà Đông
vnMovie.description: Wartime epic involving a poverty-stricken family who struggle to make ends meet, and the mother who does the unthinkable to provide her daughters with the traditional silk dresses required to attend school.

vnMovie.name: Chị Chị Em Em
vnMovie.description: This is a psychological film exploring the love story revolving around two beautiful women - Thien Kim and Bao Nhi. Face to face in a game where only one person wins, when the happiness of a small home is about to be swept away by a storm, who will fiercely fight for what they want and who will resign to keep peaceful?

vnMovie.name: Linh Miêu: Quỷ Nhập Tràng
vnMovie.description: The mysterious death of Gia Cường, the cherished eldest grandson, forces Mệ Bích to resort to the dark art of the "spirit cat" to resurrect him, unaware that a demon comes along with it. A series of chilling, nightmarish events soon begins to haunt the Dương Phúc family.

vnMovie.name: Tro tàn rực rỡ
vnMovie.description: Relationships between three women and their partners in a southern seaside village.

vnMovie.name: Thất Sơn Tâm Linh
vnMovie.description: The story about Vietnam's first serial killer.

vnMovie.name: Đêm Tối Rực Rỡ!
vnMovie.description: When his grandfather passed away, Xuan Thanh's entire family gathered to see him off. The funeral took place magnificently, crowded and colorful. Suddenly a group of people came to collect the debt to everyone's surprise. Secrets are exposed, tragedy upon tragedy, as a traumatic consequence of haunting domestic violence.

vnMovie.name: Bi, Đừng Sợ!
vnMovie.description: In an old house in Hanoi, Bi, a 6-year-old child lives with his parents, his aunt and their cook. His favorite playgrounds are an ice factory and the wild grass along the river. After being absent for years, his grandfather, serio...

vnMovie.description: A deep in debt amateur hustler (Khoa) decides to up his game when he meets a professional scammer (Tú) who inaugurates him into the world of big-crime heist. They go all in on a job and a mad scramble ensues for the duo not to los...

vnMovie.name: Gặp Lại Chị Bầu
vnMovie.description: A heartwarming family film filled with laughter for the Year of the Dragon. “Gặp Lại Chị Bầu” centers around Phuc, a young man passionate about acting who faces countless hardships. By chance, he ends up in Mrs. Le's boarding house and, together with his friends there, experiences the most memorable days of his youth.

vnMovie.name: Đào, Phở Và Piano
vnMovie.description: The film is set in the winter-spring battle that lasted 60 days and nights from late 1946 to early 1947 in Hanoi, the story follows the militiaman Van Dan and his love story with the piano-loving lady Thuc Huong. When others had evacuated to the war zone, they decided to defend the capital that had been devastated by bombs and bullets, despite the dangers that awaited them.

vnMovie.name: Lật Mặt 3: Ba Chàng Khuyết
vnMovie.description: Abandoned as children, three friends with disabilities find fame on TV — leading them on an adventure to find the mother who left one of them behind.

vnMovie.name: Chị Mười Ba: 3 Ngày Sinh Tử
Anh Trai Yêu Quái
vnMovie.description: A Judo champion has just lost his vision in a competitive match, and now has to deal with his older half-brother who has just come back home from prison.

vnMovie.name: Bắc Kim Thang
vnMovie.description: Thien Tam, a young but weak boy comes home after his treatment at the hospital to find that his cousin-sister, Hai Lam, has gone away from home. Tam decides to go look for her but then finds something horrible behind her missing.

vnMovie.name: Mười: Lời Nguyền Trở Lại
vnMovie.description: When a young art seller is surprisingly reconciled with her long-lost best friend, both are drawn into a series of frightening supernatural events at a mysterious mansion, where an infamous spirit trapped in a painting is lurking to unleash its century-old curse once again.

vnMovie.name: Gái Già Lắm Chiêu 3
vnMovie.description: Scandalous TV host Quyen travels to her fiance's hometown hoping to uncover a mysterious showbiz secret. But she just might uncover more than she had bargained on.

vnMovie.name: Chị Trợ Lý Của Anh
vnMovie.description: Doanh (Mỹ Tâm) - a beautiful and talented business woman who want to save her family business. And the only way to do it is becoming an assistant for a "playboy" guy.

vnMovie.name: Quỷ Cẩu
vnMovie.description: The return of Nam and his girlfriend Xuan brings countless troubles to the family. He gradually discovers the broken relationships of the family members.

vnMovie.name: Lật Mặt 2: Phim Trường
vnMovie.description: Two brothers help a triad boss to smuggle illegal goods in exchange for their film fund. However, they soon discover that they have fallen into a trap set by the triad.

vnMovie.name: Tôi Thấy Hoa Vàng Trên Cỏ Xanh
vnMovie.description: Set in the countryside village of Vietnam, Yellow Flowers on the Green grass is a touching tale of innocent love, friendships and brotherhood.

vnMovie.name: Nhà Không Bán
vnMovie.description: The story happened in the early 90s, Mrs. Ngoc returned to her hometown to sell her father's old house with her brother, Mr. Nga. In the first days when they returned to their hometown to live in an old house, they encountered many strange phenomena. Because of the secrets and word of mouth of the villagers about the old house being haunted by the ghost of Miss Trinh, the guests who came to buy the house also left. The story only really started when Mrs. Mai Lien - Mr. Nga's wife died mysteriously, and Betty's granddaughter Ngoc returned to her hometown with her was also missing, everything began to gradually reveal interesting and non-stop drama. by the end of the movie.

vnMovie.name: Lật Mặt 5: 48h
vnMovie.description: On the run from the mob after a deal goes wrong, an ex-fighter has two days to settle the score with the boss - or risk losing his wife and child.

vnMovie.name: Lật Mặt 6: Tấm Vé Định Mệnh
vnMovie.description: A friend group bought a lottery ticket and won the jackpot but the ticket holder of the ticket accidentally died. Some of the surviving friends intended to unravel their friend and retrieve the winning ticket, some don't.

vnMovie.name: Kẻ Ăn Hồn
vnMovie.description: Mysterious deaths occur in a community where someone, or something, is brewing The Skull Wine, the oldest form of dark magic.

vnMovie.name: Người Vợ Cuối Cùng
vnMovie.description: In the midst of the Nguyễn Dynasty, a reluctant wife's life takes a dramatic turn when a chance encounter with her childhood lover sparks a series of unexpected events.

vnMovie.name: Cô Gái Từ Quá Khứ
vnMovie.description: When a famous celebrity with a dark past meets an old friend from 15 years ago, secrets start to come back from the grave…

vnMovie.name: Tiệc Trăng Máu
vnMovie.description: Four childhood friends and their wives at an upscale dinner party. After a much-heated discussion about how smartphones influence their personal lives, the group proposes a late-night game:  everyone is to place their mobiles on the table; whoever gets a text, notification or call must share it with the group. It is a recipe for disaster.

vnMovie.name: Đất Rừng Phương Nam
vnMovie.description: As French colonial rule reaches a violent end in Vietnam, a 12 year old boy makes a treacherous journey in search of his estranged father.

vnMovie.name: Nhà Bà Nữ
vnMovie.description: The story revolves around Mrs. Nu's family consisting of three generations living together in the same house. The one-handed Mrs. Nu is known for her crab cakes and is also notorious for controlling the lives of everyone, from her daughter to her son-in-law. Everything was going normally until the youngest daughter fell in love with a handsome guy from a rich family. The story depicts the complex, multi-dimensional relationships that occur with family members. The main tagline (message) "Everyone is at fault, but everyone thinks they are... the victim" contains many hidden meanings about the content the film wants to convey.

vnMovie.name: Án Mạng Lầu 4
vnMovie.description: With just a few hours before heading to the airport, a kind-hearted couple agreed to babysit a newborn baby from their neighbor. Little did they know, shortly thereafter, they discovered that the baby had passed away since... A thrilling and heart-wrenching story unfolded in the fateful evening at their old apartment building. The couple had to rack their brains to escape this dire situation, while also uncovering the culprit who pushed them into this predicament.

vnMovie.name: Cô Dâu Đại Chiến
vnMovie.description: In the heart of Saigon, Thai and Linh are getting married. But the wedding is suddenly cut short when four other brides show up – threatening to take the groom's life. It turns out that Thai is the biggest player in the city, and has been dating all five women at the same time up until the day of his wedding. Trang is an overly jealous flight attendant, Mai Chau is a doctor who loves to party, Quyen is a sexually aggressive chef while Huynh Phuong is one fiery actress.

vnMovie.name: Đẹp Từng Centimet
vnMovie.description: An aspiring photographer tries to convince a girl to pose for his "art photos" by pretending to be a director. Ngo Dong (by Ha) dreams of becoming a famous actress. Quang Hy (by Hai) wants to take nude “artistic’ photos. They meet and Quang Hy lies that he’s a director to get Ngo Dong to participate in taking photos. Their relationship begins.

vnMovie.name: Nụ Hôn Thần Chết
vnMovie.description: Within 3 days, Du must kiss An and take away her soul, or he'll face the most terrifying curse against Deaths. However, the naive Prince of Death was wooed by the hot-headed yet flirtatious An into saving her life multiple times. While trying to stay alive, An found something more important than life itself - love.

vnMovie.name: Ma Da
vnMovie.description: In the dark waters of the Mekong River, corpse collector Le confronts MA DA - the vengeful drowning spirit, after it abducts her daughter. Determined to save her child, Mrs. Le embarks on a desperate rescue to prevent her child's ghostly fate beneath the waters.

vnSeries.name: Yêu Anh Ngàn Chông Gai
vnSeries.description: A music reality competition, where male celebrities overcome challenges through music and performances.

vnSeries.name: Tiệm Ăn Của Quỷ
vnSeries.description: In a secluded part of town, a mysterious chef cooks up supernatural meals that grant his guests' deepest desires – if they're willing to pay the price.

vnSeries.name: Hùng Long Phong Bá (Phần 2)
vnSeries.description: Wreaking havoc in the Cho Lon area to make a living, can the four brothers Hung, Long, Phong, and Ba stay united when they are all swept into the underworld's vortex of money and power?

vnSeries.name: Tết Ở Làng Địa Ngục
vnSeries.description: The descendants of an infamous group of bandits investigate a series of brutal murders in their village. Is this karma or the work of a vengeful human?
